g.text: `espruino/BangleApps` · Gordon Williams · MIT, every app included
`d3nd3/BangleApps` · no source change of our own · 6212 behind upstream, 0 ahead
nodejs workflow · `npm test` = `bin/sanitycheck.js` plus eslint over every app
`localStorage` · chosen device, favourites, BLE flag, stats toggle
watch storage · one `.info` JSON per installed app is the diff input
`index.html` · Spectre shell, fixed script order, no bundler
`loader.js` · device chooser, install and reinstall, stats, language picker
`core/js/comms.js` and `core/lib/espruinotools.js` · pinned EspruinoTools copy, Web Bluetooth
Bangle.js 1 and 2 · Espruino firmware, BLE UART, 28-character filenames
GitHub Pages · release at banglejs.com/apps, dev at espruino.github.io
`sendUsageStats` · POST to banglejs.com/submit_app_stats.php — `uid`, firmware, app ids, favourites
eslint, acorn, http-server · development only, nothing at runtime
